cohort: Women who underwent caesarean section at a single institution between 2009 and 2015 (n=24,761)
finding: Obese women (BMI ≥50 kg/m2) had significantly longer anaesthesia and surgery times for caesarean delivery compared to women with normal BMI.
mod_finding: This study focused on cesarean delivery in obese women and did not compare different modes of delivery.
